question:
Which of the option figures is the exact mirror image of the given problem figure when the mirror is held at the right side?

Problem figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf0b7ccf01e093bc90946feafaa69a86558b8ae40cb4252c23c3f59b5109908c.png]
solution:
The mirror image of the given pattern when a mirror MN is placed at right side is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f6d6c5bed990d5f73030d05bbfad40b76b3c91a37278beebc45fbe09778b157.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

1) Head of arrow is in wrong direction.

2) The pattern matches completely.

3) Head of arrow is in wrong direction.

4) The shaded region in the arrow is not placed correctly.

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
